remarks: On picturesque Greenley Road in the heart of New Canaan, this beautifully crafted residence blends charm, comfort, and sophistication on two private acres with a sparkling heated pool. Perfectly scaled, the home offers generous spaces for entertaining while maintaining a welcoming, manageable feel. Step inside to discover elegant living areas filled with natural light, high ceilings, and thoughtful details. The vaulted breakfast area with exposed beams and arched window opens to serene views through two sets of sliding French doors. A gracious living room features a fireplace, transom window, and French doors leading to a terrace that overlooks the pool, perfect for indoor-outdoor gatherings. The formal dining room is anchored by a lovely built-in corner detail and chair rail, while the study offers a bay window and fireplace, ideal for work-from-home or quiet reading. At the heart of the home, the custom Deane kitchen is appointed with top-tier appliances: Viking cooktop, dual Dacor ovens, Sub-Zero refrigerator, Miele dishwasher, and Marvel wine refrigerator. Overlooking the breakfast area, the kitchen flows seamlessly into the family room with built-ins and French doors. Built-in speakers in the kitchen, family room, breakfast area, and dining room enhance every occasion. Upstairs, there is a luxurious primary suite and additional bedrooms and baths providing flexibility, including one with striking windows that works beautifully as a home office or guest suite.
